We think your AI tools' memory should be something you can open and read, not a black box.

S3 Brain keeps it as a readable Markdown folder on your Mac. It works with 18 AI tools and in 11 languages.

· Background summaries are optional: bring your own API key, or run a local model such as Ollama or LM Studio
· A guided assistant sets up your memory folder, your AI tools and how memories are saved
· No Python to install: the app brings its own runtime
· It lives in your menu bar and tells you exactly what needs you

Free for personal use, macOS 14 or later.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-brain
